fusions.name: Ram and Rend
fusions.desc: A head-down charge that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Ledge Pounce
fusions.desc: A drop from above that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Hold the Narrow Path
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A packmate fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mountain-Bred
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and your armour by 5%.
